name: Insights · Flow Count Kpi
query:
query FlowCountKpi($pageNumber: Int!, $pageSize: Int!, $dateRange: DateRange!, $groupBy: [FlowCountGrouping]!, $filters: FlowCountFilters) {
  flowCountKpi(page: { number: $pageNumber, size: $pageSize }, dateRange: $dateRange, groupBy: $groupBy, filters: $filters) {
    count
    total
    pageNumber
    pageSize
    data {
  rowCount
  inCountSum
  outCountSum
  rawInsideCountSum
  displayInsideCountSum
  inCountMin
  outCountMin
  rawInsideCountMin
  displayInsideCountMin
  inCountMax
  outCountMax
  rawInsideCountMax
  displayInsideCountMax
  inCountAvg
  outCountAvg
  rawInsideCountAvg
  displayInsideCountAvg
  capacityMin
  capacityMax
  capacityAvg
  capacitySum
  buildingId
  floorId
  spaceId
  year
  quarter
  month
  day
  dayOfWeek
  date
  hour
  timeSlot
            building {
              name
            }
            floor {
              name
            }
            space {
              name
            }
}
  }
}

name: Reservation · Extend Reservation by specified number of minutes
Reservation · Extend Reservation to new utc end date

Reservation · Gets a single reservation CheckIn/Out Types: 1 = Automatic, 2 = Manual User, 3 = Manual Admin Hoteling Status: NotCheckedIn = 0 - The reservation is scheduled to begin in the future and has not been checked-in yet. CheckedIn = 1 - The reservation is checked-in and resources are in use. CheckedOut = 2 - The reservation is completed and checked-out. Resources are not in use. AutoReleased = 3 - The reservation has been auto-released due to failure to check-in within allowed time period. Resources are not in use. Canceled = 4 - The reservation has been canceled by the user. Resources are not in use. CanCancel = 5 - The reservation can be canceled. This status is used by the Kiosk application to provide a Cancel button from the result collection. CanStartNow = 6 - The reservation can be started immediately. This status is used by the Kiosk application to provide a StartNow button from the result collection.

Reservation · Create Reservation Note: ReservationCategoryId and ReservationTypeId will need to be explicitly set to -1 if no value exists, otherwise they will be saved as the first valid color in each respective list.

query Bookings($pageNumber: Int!, $pageSize: Int!, $dateRange: DateRange!, $filters: BookingFilters) {
  bookings(page: { number: $pageNumber, size: $pageSize }, dateRange: $dateRange, filters: $filters) {
    count
    total
    pageNumber
    pageSize
    data {
  id
  date

  resourceGroupId

}
  }
